description: Command-line tool of the Flutter Bond framework: creates projects from the flutter-bond template and generates models, widgets and service providers inside them.
rules: Install with dart pub global activate bond_cli (requires Dart 3.13 or newer).
bond create project --projectName <name> --bundleId <ios.bundle.id> [--applicationId <android.id>] [--appName <name>] [--ref v2.0.0] [--template-url <git url or path>].

Generators: bond create model --name UserDetail --feature profile; bond create widget --name ProfileCard --type consumer --feature profile; bond create service_provider --name Profile --feature profile. Files go to lib/features/<feature>/.
